name: Design Hero
source:
Is a game where you must learn how to work with the creative team of all kind of creatives and deal with deadly clients. Your goal is to be the next design legend.

Start as intern of the most prestigious design agency in the world: Jagger & Jones.

Depending on your decisions you will improve your relationship with your colleagues, maybe you can discover your new love or your new enemy.

Will you become the next creative rockstar?

[From [url=https://akinaba.itch.io/designhero]itch.io[/url]]
